## Data source
[IPUMS USA](www.ipums.org) 

```{r}
#| label: Load IPUMS data
# instal.packages("ipumsr")
library(ipumsr)
# NOTE: To load data, you must download both the extract's data and the DDI
# and also set the working directory to the folder with these files (or change the path below).

if (!require("ipumsr")) stop("Reading IPUMS data into R requires the ipumsr package. It can be installed using the following command: install.packages('ipumsr')")

ddi <- read_ipums_ddi("usa_00043.xml")
data <- read_ipums_micro(ddi)
```

```{r}
#| label: Distribution of usual hours worked by gender

library(tidyverse)

data |>
  filter(AGE > 15 & WKSWORK1 > 0) |>
  mutate(
    UHRSWORK = ifelse(UHRSWORK == 99, NA, UHRSWORK)
  ) |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = UHRSWORK, y = factor(SEX))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, staplewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of usual hours worked by gender",
    subtitle = "Among individuals 15 years and older and worked last year"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    name = "Sex",                         
    labels = c("1" = "Male", "2" = "Female")
  ) +
  xlab("Usual hours worked per week") +
  theme_minimal()
  

```
